page.notes: Doubtful readings: "LAkislaus" (large L joined to the word, the word may be Ladislaus) and its page reference "43[?]" are uncertain. "Iromia" is read as printed. "Thebanus" and "Iesuitæ" are read from the scan with some doubt. Column text runs from the left column into the right column at the word "Iai-cus", which is kept whole across the break. No page number or signature is printed.
